alternative.src/ranges.mjs: export function canonical(ranges){const events=new Map();for(const [a,b]of ranges){if(a===b)continue;events.set(a,(events.get(a)??0)+1);events.set(b,(events.get(b)??0)-1);}let depth=0,start;const out=[];for(const point of [...events.keys()].sort((a,b)=>a-b)){const previous=depth;depth+=events.get(point);if(previous===0&&depth>0)start=point;if(previous>0&&depth===0)out.push([start,point]);}return out;}export function subtract(ranges,start,end){if(start===end)return canonical(ranges);const out=[];for(const [a,b]of canonical(ranges)){if(b<=start||a>=end)out.push([a,b]);else{if(a<start)out.push([a,start]);if(b>end)out.push([end,b]);}}return out;}export function createRanges(initial=[]){let ranges=canonical(initial);return {add(a,b){ranges=canonical([...ranges,[a,b]]);},remove(a,b){ranges=subtract(ranges,a,b);},contains(n){return ranges.some(([a,b])=>a<=n&&n<b);},snapshot(){return ranges.map(r=>[...r]);}};}
